[Act: transfer-of-property
 Chapter: Of Gifts
 Section: 129::Saving of donations mortis causa and Muhammadan law.
]


Nothing in this Chapter related to gifts of moveable property made in contemplation of death, or shall be deemed to affect any rule of Muhammadan law 2***.

metadata.section_title: Saving of donations mortis causa and Muhammadan law.
